accounts.name: userQuoteAccount

instructions.name: closeEpochV3
docs: Close and fund the mandatory FIFO prefix at one pricing snapshot.

accounts.name: idleAccount
docs: The authority's canonical quote ATA. A delegate `token_withdraw` can
only pay out here (the core restricts delegates to the owner's ATA), and
anything here is outside NAV until swept back.

instructions.name: deactivatePerpPosition
docs: Release a flat perp position slot (permissionless cleanup).

accounts.name: idleAccount
docs: Canonical quote ATA, checked before any transfer; counted in pricing NAV.

accounts.name: idleAccount
docs: escrow before full recovery freezes terminal assets.

instructions.name: applyParams
docs: Remaining accounts only for a fee-rate change: pricing accounts, health
accounts and event queues, so the instruction accrues at the old rates.

instructions.name: abortUnwind
docs: Admin: leave proportional or full recovery and return to live trading
with deposits paused and no delegate. Expanded vaults pass the sidecar.

instructions.name: initFermiAccountV4
docs: Admin: a FermiAccount with up to 13 perp slots and the recovery store.

instructions.name: cureDeferred
docs: Delegate or admin: fund the deferred head at its own close price.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The vault's delegate or admin.

instructions.name: triggerPartialUnwind
docs: Admin or guardian: proportional reduction by `fraction_bps` without a batch.

instructions.name: permissionedWithdraw
docs: Approved wallet, before graduation: redeem shares at once at NAV_low.

accounts.name: feeShareAccount
docs: Fee recipient's share ATA. It may be missing while an accrual mints no
fee shares.

instructions.name: initDepositor
docs: Anyone: create a wallet's Depositor record (no deposit approval).

accounts.name: RecoveryTargets
docs: Additional account, not a reallocation of the frozen PR23 Vault layout.
Expanded vaults require this PDA as the last remaining account on recovery
and epoch-close instructions. Existing four-market vaults remain unchanged.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The currently open epoch.

fields.name: owedUnmintedShares
docs: Shares owed to depositors of closed epochs but not yet claimed
(non-transferable shares are minted on claim).

fields.name: lockedShares
docs: Shares burned by withdraw requests whose batch has not settled yet.
They still count toward supply and bear PnL until settlement.

fields.name: deadShares
docs: Seed shares minted to the authority's share account; never redeemable.

fields.name: deferredHead
docs: Oldest / newest deferred withdrawal batch (NONE_EPOCH when none).

fields.name: hwmPriceE12
docs: Price per share (quote native per share native) × 1e12.

fields.name: heldDeposits
docs: Deposits of epochs closed during unwind. They stay in the deposit escrow
until `refund_pending_deposit` returns them; they never bought shares.

fields.name: graduationNum
docs: Fixed conversion for public escrow at graduation. These claims remain
in pricing supply until the original depositors receive their shares.

fields.name: reserved
docs: PR23 extension: timing [0..9], equity marker [9], current/pending window [10..18],
expanded recovery marker [18], deferred-head funding failure [19..28],
delegate to restore after a proportional recovery [28..61].

fields.name: supply
docs: Pricing supply (mint supply + owed + locked) after fee accrual.

fields.name: depNum
docs: Deposit price as a ratio: shares = net × dep_num / dep_den. `dep_den == 0`
with `dep_gross > 0` marks deposits held for refund (closed during unwind).

fields.name: wdCloseNum
docs: Price at close: usdc = shares × wd_close_num / wd_close_den.

fields.name: wdNum
docs: Price fixed atomically when this batch is funded.

fields.name: netted
docs: Legacy wire field; zero because RC1 has no escrow netting path.

fields.name: nextDeferred
docs: Next deferred batch after this one (NONE_EPOCH if last).

fields.name: sharesHeld
docs: Claimed shares held in the user's wallet (mirror; non-transferable).

fields.name: costBasis
docs: Average-cost basis of `shares_held`, in quote native.

fields.name: preDepositAmount
docs: Public principal. Never part of trading shares before graduation.

fields.name: maxStepQuote
docs: Quote native units; caps each IOC's oracle notional and quote budget.

fields.name: mode
docs: 0 = inactive, 1 = proportional, 2 = full. Only full can close the vault.

fields.name: targetBaseLots
docs: Signed target inventory. Only a failed eligible payout can extend a
completed proportional target; individual IOC cranks cannot overshoot it.

fields.name: epochDurationS
docs: Epoch length in seconds (3 days on mainnet).

fields.name: requestCutoffS
docs: Requests made less than this many seconds before an epoch ends target
the following epoch.

fields.name: timelockS
docs: Delay between `propose_delegate` and `activate_delegate`, and between
`stage_params` and `apply_params` (subject to the exit-window floor).

fields.name: upnlHaircutBps
docs: Haircut applied to positive unsettled perp PnL in NAV_low.

fields.name: minPostWithdrawInitRatioBps
docs: A settlement withdrawal must leave the Init health ratio at or above
this (in bps of the core's percentage ratio, i.e. 3000 = 30%).

fields.name: tvlCap
docs: 0 = uncapped.

fields.name: equityWindowS
docs: Seconds after a scheduled epoch end during which a close funds exits.
Bounded by `MIN_EQUITY_WINDOW_S..=MAX_EQUITY_WINDOW_S` and changed only
through the timelocked parameter path, like every other policy value.

types.name: LegacyVaultParams
docs: PR23 wire parameters. New policy lives in the reserved account extension.

fields.name: epochDurationS
docs: Epoch length in seconds (3 days on mainnet).

fields.name: requestCutoffS
docs: Requests made less than this many seconds before an epoch ends target
the following epoch.

fields.name: timelockS
docs: Delay between `propose_delegate` and `activate_delegate`, and between
`stage_params` and `apply_params` (subject to the exit-window floor).

fields.name: upnlHaircutBps
docs: Haircut applied to positive unsettled perp PnL in NAV_low.

fields.name: minPostWithdrawInitRatioBps
docs: A settlement withdrawal must leave the Init health ratio at or above
this (in bps of the core's percentage ratio, i.e. 3000 = 30%).

fields.name: tvlCap
docs: 0 = uncapped.

fields.name: depositsNet
docs: Deposits after the deposit fee, summed from per-request net amounts so
that per-user claims can never exceed the aggregate mint.

types.name: NavSnapshot
docs: NAV of the vault's FermiAccount, in quote (USDC) native units.

fields.name: initRatioBps
docs: Init health ratio in bps (the core's percentage × 100); i64::MAX when the
account has no liabilities.

fields.name: spotQuote
docs: Spot quote-token balance held in the FermiAccount (withdrawable
without borrowing, before health limits).

fields.name: netDeposits
docs: total deposited (gross) − total withdrawn (net). Base for dollar PnL.

fields.name: amount
docs: Deposit: gross USDC. Withdraw: shares.

fields.name: aux
docs: Deposit: net USDC after fee. Withdraw: cost basis released.
